x: a positive integer leg in the Pythagorean triple
y: the other positive integer leg in the Pythagorean triple
z: the positive integer hypotenuse in the Pythagorean triple
A: the half-sum (z+x)/2 used in the forward parametrization
B: the half-difference (z-x)/2 used in the forward parametrization
m: the larger positive integer parameter in the parametrization
n: the smaller positive integer parameter in the parametrization
p: a prime integer used in divisibility arguments
d: a positive integer used as a possible common divisor of m and n
